WP_SCAN_API.title: WordPress Vulnerability Database API token
WP_SCAN_API.description: An optional WordPress Vulnerability Database API token to retrieve WordPress vulnerability data in real time. See https://wpscan.com/api and https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/wiki/WPScan-User-Documentation#optional-wordpress-vulnerability-database-api for more information.

TIMEOUT.title: TIMEOUT
TIMEOUT.description: Maximum time in seconds the wpscan may run. Defaults to 1800. When exceeded the boefje reports a timeout.
